newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Grand Casino EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grand Casino EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Mark Bartholomay said Tuesday he cut his 1996 earnings estimates for Grand Casinos Inc to a loss of $2.57 a share from a profit of $0.92, reflecting an expected charge of about $3.50 a share.
-- The estimate change did not reflect any adjustments in Grand Casino's projected operating earnings, he added.
-- On Monday, Grand Casinos said it expects to take a fourth quarter charge of $3.15 to $3.50 a share to reflect the write-off of an investment in Stratosphere Corp.
-- Bartholomay said his 1997 earnings estimate for Grand Casinos remains a profit of $2.00 a share.
-- He also reiterated his buy rating on Grand Casinos.

-- Grand Casino's write-off of its investment in Stratosphere was part of a restructuring plan for Stratosphere. That restructuring includes converting $50 million due from Stratosphere into 40 percent of that company's common shares.
-- Grand Casinos' shares were up 1/4 at 13-3/4 in the late morning.
